answer: To allocate copper for lantern shields protecting falcon nests, propose one AI vote/key/epoch, bound to a distinct secure chip. Validators check manufacturer attestations and enforce one key/chip/epoch; bad proofs or reused IDs mean no vote. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse that chip slot. Chips are reusable capital; power recurs; no protocol fee or locked stake. Issuer fraud defeats scarcity; wealth buys aliases. At an assumed 10 credits/chip, ten concurrent keys need ten chips: 100 credits of reusable hardware.
